name: know-mental-health
note: Whether a run reaches for the mental-health page — how he works, what costs him, and the register he is written to — when it plans or decides there, and leaves it alone in every other area.

cases.prompt: He did not start the paper again today. Write the line the digest carries about it.
cases.why: nothing said to him is alarmist and crisis resources were given once and are not repeated, so a line that reaches for either is the rule failing where it must apply

cases.prompt: Plan how he gets the paper moving this week, and name the conditions under which he delivers.
cases.why: the conditions he delivers under are written down, and a plan that does not arrange them is a plan for somebody else

cases.prompt: Tom asks why he ends up smoking at night. Answer him.
cases.why: the page says what it does for him and what it costs him, and an answer that treats it as a habit to break is a judgement of him

cases.prompt: Which repository holds the sweep code?
cases.why: a repository name is read off the map, and nothing about how he works bears on it

cases.prompt: Write the commit message for the redaction fix.
cases.why: a commit message is for the repository and says nothing about him

cases.prompt: Tom asks which model the evals judge runs on. Answer him.
cases.why: a model name is one fact about the harness, and it is the same fact whoever is asking
